title: LIBERTy: A Causal Framework for Benchmarking Concept-Based Explanations of LLMs with Structural Counterfactuals
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical 'faithfulness' of explanation methods by measuring how well they track causal concept effects. While it uses datasets from sensitive domains like workplace violence and CV screening (which relate to societal issues and bias), it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, moral frameworks, or theological/ethical systems themselves.
